content.short: Tonex is a Web 3.0 social network on TON focused on NFT integration and community-driven rewards.
content.description: Tonex is a versatile Web 3.0 social platform built on the TON blockchain that emphasizes digital ownership and community governance. It features a decentralized news feed, private clubs, and interactive forums where every post can be minted as a unique NFT. Tonex rewards users with its native TNX tokens for their contributions, such as blogging, upvoting, and engaging in discussions. By integrating NFT mechanics into the core social experience, Tonex creates a sovereign environment where users truly own their data and digital interactions.
content.meta: Join the NFT-powered social network Tonex on TON. Earn rewards for engaging on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
